title: Compose confinement with an explicitly paid boundary budget conditionally
statement: If a uniform explicit n_L=Theta(L^D) family has fixed-support safety, noisy native boundaries with eta_enc+eta_dec<=1/100, and every allowed complete perturbation obeys q_L(s)<=A exp(-kappa n_L^alpha) throughout the exponential window, the logical-safety lemma gives physical decoded diamond error<=1/100+C L^D(1+t)exp(-2c L^(D alpha)) for sufficiently small fixed c. Boundary contractivity pays eta_enc+eta_dec. Ideal thermal encoding U(rho tensor rho_beta,syn)U^dagger and polynomial Clifford/SWAP specification do not prove noisy thermal preparation or these boundary bounds. Both robust confinement and complete native boundary remain unconstructed, so this is a conditional theorem, not the requested threshold.
